We received your request (Ticket C-2316) to update the billing contact address for Fabrikam Ltd, as invoices are currently going to an old address. Our contract system shows the current billing contact as accounts@fabrikam.co.

Could you please confirm the new billing contact email address you'd like us to use going forward?

Thank you,
IT Operations Team
